tools.name: requestNewTest
tools.description: Requests that a not yet tested page be tested. Call this tool after listSites or listPages. Requires either a siteID from listSites if the site has been tested, or a siteName, namely the brand or organization name of the site, like the names shown by listSites, but distinct from the name of any tested site when lower-cased and stripped of punctuation and white space. Also requires a pageName describing the purpose of the page, such as home, about, contact, shop, blog, subscribe, sign up, or Benefactors Club; a URL; and a reason justifying the request. If the site has been tested, the pageName must be distinct from the names of all other tested pages of the site shown by listPages. Permits an optional boolean reviewImmediately parameter. If it is true, the response will notify you of approval (with a report identifier, and with an opportunity to call awaitTest and wait for, typically, 2 to 4 minutes), rejection, or queuing for management review. If reviewImmediately is false or omitted, the request will be queued for management review (approval and test completion typically take an hour to a day). If the page has already been tested, call requestRetest instead.
